logoRevision.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create a finished professional horizontal brand logo lockup for a warm Turkish family farm, transparent background. Exact text: "Yıldız" as the large main brand word in refined bold elegant dark olive green serif lettering, with exact subtitle "ORGANİK ÜRÜNLER" below it in dark olive small spaced uppercase letters, clearly readable and spelled with correct Turkish letters. On the left a simplified tasteful emblem: a dark olive hen in a muted golden sun circle, a small star above and two minimal wheat sprigs below. Overall horizontal aspect ratio about 3:1, emblem roughly one third of width, typography two thirds. Warm premium countryside brand, restrained organic curves, crisp flat vector-like design, no textures no gradients no shadows no mockup, no extra decorative text, no background color. Logo tightly framed with modest transparent padding. Brand spelling must be exactly Yıldız and ORGANİK ÜRÜNLER. Optimize subtitle weight for readability on website headers at 220px logo width.

signatureLogo.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create a sophisticated signature-style horizontal logo for a Turkish family farm brand. Exact main text "Yıldız", with correct Turkish dotless ı in both positions. Main lettering MUST be expressive custom handwritten signature calligraphy, flowing connected letterforms, elegant natural pen strokes, long graceful sweeping capital Y entry stroke and an understated swash under the word, warm authentic artisan identity, NOT serif typesetting, NOT block letters. It must remain clearly legible. Exact subtitle "ORGANİK ÜRÜNLER" in clean bold small widely spaced uppercase sans-serif underneath. A small restrained farm emblem at left: simple olive hen silhouette in a muted harvest-gold sun, a tiny star, minimal wheat sprig; emblem secondary to large signature. Main word in deep olive green, one subtle golden accent on swash. Flat crisp vector-like design, transparent background, no texture, no shadows, no mockup. Horizontal aspect ratio 3:1. Balanced whitespace and good readability when displayed at 240px wide, subtitle sufficiently bold. The signature word is the hero of this logo.
